author: rorupuntou
content:
Quick update on Python tooling for Kohaku and EDW: 

Just rolled out full engine parity in kohaku-py (https://github.com/rorupuntou/kohaku-py):
- Blinded encrypted datastore matching the EDW spec (Argon2id 64MB + ChaCha20-Poly1305 with HKDF-blinded record keys).
- Privacy-by-default fresh address rotation along m/44'/60'/x'/0/i.
- Gasless unshielding to virgin addresses (relayer fees reimbursed directly from Tornado pool notes, so fresh recipients require 0 prior ETH/gas).
- Anonymous payment invoices (edw-invoice:v1:...) exposing only commitments.
- Native pure-Python RFC 1928 SOCKS5/Tor routing for raw tx broadcasts without IP leakage.
- Terminal desktop wallet UI (edw tui / kohaku tui).

Backed by 27 unit tests passing in ~4s. Opened a docs PR on desktop-wallet (#113) and updated the tracker on kohaku (#335). Hope it's useful for anyone wanting to script or test privacy flows without compiler overhead!
